question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH monthly_delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS order_month,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS cnt_2016,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS cnt_2017,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS cnt_2018
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT 
    order_month,
    cnt_2016 AS "2016",
    cnt_2017 AS "2017",
    cnt_2018 AS "2018"
FROM monthly_delivered
ORDER BY order_month
